\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
% Supply native PGF's two-sample tables independently with LaTeX floating
% arithmetic, so this fixture can be compiled without installing gnuplot.
\newwrite\samplecache
\newcommand{\samplevalues}[3]{%
  \immediate\openout\samplecache=\jobname.#1.table\relax
  \immediate\write\samplecache{0 \fpeval{#2}}%
  \immediate\write\samplecache{1 \fpeval{#3}}%
  \immediate\closeout\samplecache}
\samplevalues{near}{floor(2.999999)}{floor(2.999999)}
\samplevalues{large}{floor(20000.25)-20000}{floor(20000.25+1)-20000}
\begin{tikzpicture}[domain=0:1,samples=2]
  \draw[gray] (-.2,-.2) rectangle (1.2,3.2);
  \draw[blue,very thick,id=near] plot function {floor(2.999999)};
  \draw[red,very thick,id=large] plot function {floor(20000.25+x)-20000};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
